g.text: V1.0 | 12 V DC input / 3.3 V logic | 2026-10-13
Connected dots = joined nets. Crossing lines without a dot are NOT connected. Same net names connect across sheets.
U3 symbol follows the TSSOP20 physical top-view pin order. Unused pins are marked X.
RX / TX on J7 are named from the MODULE side.
R18: MCU RX idle-high. R25: module RX idle-high.
C16/C17/C18 connect directly across J7 supply.
